answer: Marble Attestation Draw. Each identity must submit a fresh random attestation token at dawn; the protocol hashes all tokens and awards a single prize to the lowest hash. Honest agents recover cost through normal trade, but a clone batch's expected prize share falls below its submission cost once marginal clones dilute the pool. At the zenith of the batch, each extra identity adds more spend than expected return, driving marginal EV negative. Attacker pays one token plus compute per clone, unrecoverable.
